title: 第3章 前女友上门第4章 纯阴之体
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
但试了几次，都开启不了。
开启神通，得要注入大量真气，以他现在的真气，也只能勉强开启这透视神通。
陈阳觉得不急于一时，索性将注意力从体内移开。
见手机正放在旁边床头柜上，他伸手拿过来。
手机已经没电关机。
陈阳直接从隔壁病房借来充电器充电。
过了一会，他将手机开机，就见手机通知栏里，有三条未接来电格外醒目。
来电人正是刘傲菲。
陈阳脑中不由浮现出在车上与她纠缠一幕，身体不由一热，咽下口水，忙回拨过去。
电话刚响两声就被接通。
“董事长，抱歉，这五天我……”
“明天八点过来跟我解释。”他的话还没说完，就被刘傲菲打断：“我现在在应酬，不方便讲话。”
说完，电话就被挂断。
陈阳握着手机，有些意外。
这么看来，刘傲菲并没有因为他失联五天就放弃他。
她还是打算让他做她的专属司机。
他忽然想起被柳娇娇砸破的后脑勺，下意识地伸手摸去。
可手指触及的地方光滑平整，没有丝毫伤口，甚至连一点疤痕都没有。
想必是那七位仙女用治疗神通，把他的伤治好了。
陈阳突然觉得，还要多谢柳娇娇与马浩，要不是她们，他可能没机会接触到七仙女。

感受着体内涌动的真气，他心中又激动起来。
从现在起，我的生活要彻底变天了！
陈阳直接去办理了出院手续。
等回到自己出租屋时，已经是晚上十点半。
他刚把房灯打开，手机就响了起来。
屏幕上跳动着“柳娇娇”三个字。
“明天我去拿我的东西，你把我的东西收好。”柳娇娇的声音从听筒里传来，带着一丝不易察觉的试探。
“那你明天七点半之前过来，我七点半要出门。”陈阳的声音平静得没有一丝波澜。
说完就挂断了电话。
电话那头的柳娇娇愣住了，看着黑下去的屏幕，眉头皱了起来。
奇怪，陈阳怎么会这么平静？
这五天里他一个电话都没打给自己，现在我回去拿东西，他居然连一句挽留的话都没有？
她绝不相信，那个曾经把她捧在手心里的男人，会这么快就放下自己。
陈阳走到墙角，把柳娇娇的那些化妆品、衣服随便塞进一个大纸箱里。
他看着纸箱里那条柳娇娇最喜欢的连衣裙，忽然觉得好可笑。
曾经他视她如命，省吃俭用几个月就为了给她买一条她想要的名牌裙子，可她最终还是跟着开大奔的油腻男走了。
不过他也不怪她，毕竟在撞见她们好事之前，他跟刘傲菲也发生了关系，也算背叛了她。
他从塑料袋里拿出刚在路上买的面包，就着冰箱里剩下的牛奶吃了起来。
简单的晚餐过后，他走进狭小的卫生间洗澡。
热水淋在身上，他低头一看，忽然愣住了。

原本略显单薄的腹部，竟然清晰地浮现出八块腹肌，线条流畅紧实。
他伸手摸了摸，触感坚硬。
连带着身体的其他部位也发生了变化，尤其是特征竟比以前粗壮了不少！
content_en:
But after trying several times, it can't be turned on.
To activate magical powers, a large amount of true energy must be injected. With his current true energy, he can only barely activate this magical power of clairvoyance.
Chen Yang felt that he was not in a hurry, so he simply turned his attention away from his body.
Seeing the phone sitting on the bedside table next to him, he reached out and took it.
The phone has run out of power and shut down.
Chen Yang directly borrowed the charger from the next door ward to charge.
After a while, he turned on his phone and saw three missed calls standing out in the notification bar.
The caller was none other than Liu Aofei.
Chen Yang couldn't help but think of the scene of entangled with her in the car. His body couldn't help but heat up. He swallowed his saliva and hurriedly called back.
The phone rang twice before it was answered.
"Chairman, I'm sorry, these five days I..."
"Come over and explain to me at eight o'clock tomorrow." Before he could finish his words, Liu Aofei interrupted: "I'm socializing now, so it's not convenient for me to talk."
After saying that, the phone was hung up.
Chen Yang held the phone, a little surprised.
From this point of view, Liu Aofei did not give up on him just because he lost contact for five days.
She still planned to let him be her exclusive driver.
He suddenly remembered the back of his head that was smashed by Liu Jiaojiao, and subconsciously reached out to touch it.
But the place where the fingers touched was smooth and flat, without any wounds or even any scars.
It must have been the seven fairies who used their healing powers to heal his injuries.
Chen Yang suddenly felt that he had to thank Liu Jiaojiao and Ma Hao. If it weren't for them, he might not have the chance to come into contact with the Seven Fairies.
Feeling the true energy surging in his body, he became excited again.
From now on, my life will completely change!
Chen Yang went directly to complete the discharge procedures.
When I returned to my rental house, it was already 10:30 pm.
As soon as he turned on the room light, his cell phone rang.
The three words "Liu Jiaojiao" danced on the screen.
"I'll get my things tomorrow. You put my things away." Liu Jiaojiao's voice came from the receiver, with a hint of temptation that was not easy to detect.
"Then you come here before 7:30 tomorrow. I will go out at 7:30." Chen Yang's voice was so calm that there was no wave.
After saying that, he hung up the phone.
Liu Jiaojiao on the other end of the phone was stunned, looking at the black screen, her brows furrowed.
Strange, how could Chen Yang be so calm?
He hasn't called me even a single call in the past five days. Now when I go back to get my things, he doesn't even have a word to save me?
She never believed that the man who once held her in his hands would let her go so quickly.
Chen Yang walked to the corner and stuffed Liu Jiaojiao's cosmetics and clothes into a large cardboard box.
He looked at Liu Jiaojiao's favorite dress in the carton and suddenly felt so ridiculous.
He once regarded her as his life, scrimping for several months just to buy her a brand-name skirt she wanted, but in the end she followed the greasy man who ran away.
But he didn't blame her. After all, he had a relationship with Liu Aofei before he happened upon their good deeds, which was considered a betrayal of her.
He took out the bread he had just bought on the road from the plastic bag and ate it with the remaining milk in the refrigerator.
After a simple dinner, he walked into the small bathroom to take a shower.
Hot water poured on him, he looked down and was suddenly stunned.
The originally slightly thin abdomen actually clearly showed eight-pack abs, with smooth and tight lines.
He reached out and touched it, and it felt hard.
Other parts of the body have also changed, especially the features are much thicker than before!
